items.competency: Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees (R.A. 6713)
items.stem: During a transaction in Quezon City, a government employee is offered ₱3,000 to speed up a permit. What action does R.A. 6713 require?

options.text: Refuse the offer and disclose it if required

items.reveal: R.A. 6713 prohibits accepting anything of value that could influence official action.
